questions.stem: What must happen prior to a defendant being tried in the District Court in NSW?

options.A: The defendant must attend a committal hearing in the Local Court
options.B: The prosecution must hold a case conference with the defence counsel
options.C: The judge must review the evidence

questions.answerNote: Official THSC key says B (case conference). Disputed: A (committal hearing in the Local Court) is also plausible, as indictable matters are committed for trial to the District Court after committal. questions.stem: What action can the Federal Government take if the High Court makes a decision on a constitutional point that the Federal Government disagrees with?

options.A: It can appeal to the Privy Council
options.B: It can order the High Court to rehear the matter
options.C: It can legislate to override the decision

questions.answerNote: Official THSC key says C (legislate to override). Disputed: legislation cannot override a constitutional ruling, so D (amend the Constitution by referendum) is arguably more accurate.
